transcribed: Not captured by a script: the numbers are copied from the Duet Space Map as issue #189 quotes it and as commit 66ba654 (site/duo-mock-real) applied them. Replace with a capture from tools/e2e (slot rects from the e2e reporter, native frames from SafariViewService) when the harness can run on a free Duo e2e clone.
duetUi: 0.4.x to 0.5.0-rc (before 0.8.0-rc.1, f2d9243, moved the Duo inline foot to DUO.bottom)
units: points. band.bottom: where Duet's inline band ended on the sim, screen points, kept as measured; it depends on the duet-ui release, so it is not diffed. signals: what the page saw, derived from band.bottom by the rule of that release (bottom = height - max(insetBottom, 11), page reaching the screen's foot): the mock must post the same. native.*.top: the preview's own button tops, window points (the sheet's top left is 0,0).

contexts.label: Closed in-app preview, upright, Live Activity
